Queue file confirmed on disk at ~/.pi/agent/subagent-channel/cf76ad71-3f82-4296-960f-fa9e2fcd06ee.jsonl containing one well-formed entry from scout: {id:1788091625940-41f26e, from:3ef0e69e..., fromRole:scout, text:QUEUE-E2E-CHANTEST, ts:2026-08-30T12:07:05.940Z}.

Assistant reported Phase 1 complete: paseo-channel.ts rewritten (removed lossy 5s poll loop, replaced with persistent file queue subagent-channel/<agentId>.jsonl with rename-safe drain, single status check per send, interrupt opt-in); index.ts 3-event drain (turn_end/before_agent_start/agent_settled) wired to one atomic splice function; 45/45 unit tests pass (36 old + 9 new for file queue); tsc --noEmit clean after adding required display/details to CustomMessage.

researcher merge: researcher.md gained safe_bash, learn-researcher.md deleted, inventory went 6 to 5 roles; visual-tools dead bridge __pi_interactive_subagents removed with honest header; dev and live synced.
message_subagent gained interrupt:true opt-in param; tool descriptions updated to new semantics.
User restarted Paseo and asked 'xem ok chưa thì tiếp tục?' (check if ok then continue).

Parent-side drain E2E confirmed: after Paseo restart, a <subagent-message from=3ef0e69e... role=scout kind=message>QUEUE-E2E-CHANTEST</subagent-message> appeared in the user's message, injected via before_agent_start drain using the new renderer format; the queue file was drained and unlinked (now 0 entries).

Full E2E loop timeline: child pushed at 12:07, file persisted, Paseo restarted at 12:34-35, first prompt at 12:35 drained via before_agent_start; contrasted with old buggy behavior of 33-minute delay plus manual stop.
Phase 1 declared FULLY E2E verified; assistant moved to Phase 2: ask_question (park/wait/absorb) plus name registry and resume-by-name.

Phase 2 design: ask_question child tool pushes kind:'ask' to main queue via status-aware sendToMain, then waitForReply polls caller's OWN queue file locally every 2s (zero daemon traffic) so a reply mid-wait is absorbed into the current turn; on timeout (default 90s, max 300s, wait_seconds param) child parks its turn for next turn arrival.

Phase 2 design: name registry at ~/.pi/agent/subagent-channel/registry.json mapping name to {agentId, role, createdAt} with latest-wins; message_subagent gains optional name param (agentId XOR name) and optional kind param (message|reply); child idle path makes resume free via send_agent_prompt.

spawn_subagent has name param (line 279, 'Optional display title') used as registry key; message_subagent tool params currently message only; assistant appended Phase 2 code (RegistryEntry interface, loadRegistry, saveRegistry, registerSubagent, resolveSubagentName, waitForReply) to paseo-channel.ts.
saveRegistry initially used require('node:fs') writeFileSync/renameSync which fails in bun TS ESM; fixed by adding writeFileSync to the node:fs import and using plain writeFileSync/renameSync calls.

Assistant used python3 script to edit index.ts: added waitForReply/registerSubagent/resolveSubagentName imports, and after successful createAgent spawn with a name, calls registerSubagent with {agentId, role, title, createdAt}; script reported OK phần 1-2.
